intro.title: You already know
intro.note: Not new — you met these before. Four of them grow into this unit: confident → confidence, patient → patience, strong → strength, weak → weakness.
intro.note_cz: Nejsou nové — už je znáte. Čtyři z nich se tady mění na podstatná jména: confident → confidence, patient → patience, strong → strength, weak → weakness.

intro.title: Body and feelings
intro.body: How you feel, in both senses: the body (ache, swollen, heal) and the person (stubborn, outgoing, guilty, relieved).

intro.title: You will use these in
frames: My sister has had this cough since the weekend.
My sister felt dizzy and tired after she gave blood at the hospital.
The wound is healing well because the nurse cleans it every day.
My sister is in a good mood today because her holiday starts tomorrow.
His greatest strength is that he stays calm when everybody else is worried.
Her sister is more outgoing than she is, so she makes friends quickly.
intro.note: English separates the pain from the person: *bolí mě hlava* becomes **my head aches** — the body part is the subject, not you.

title: Self & body (B1)
note: V_SEL-B1B2-01 · B1 self layer · what the body does when something is wrong, the feelings A2 could not name yet, and the words for describing a character · F8 2026-09-04: intro starts with You already know (10 tiles; four base forms feed the new nouns) · B22 2026-09-04: quiz_mode sentence_gap — Quiz/Type were bare 1-1 word translation · P0 2026-09-04 (flag: too hard for B1) — 14 frames cut to the B1 house length (median 12, max 14) · sentences 13 → 36 (one gappable frame per word; every frame has a clause move and ≥2 recycled words) · Czech gender leaks removed (1sg past / predicate adjectives routed onto explicit non-speaker subjects) · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: E10 — Use was CZ→EN of the 36-frame bank, which grades articles and word order as if they were the lemma. use_mode rewrite with 12 underlined paraphrases now makes Use production of the new word (*very angry* → furious, *felt much better* → relieved, *sure of herself* → confidence). Nothing else touched: the word list, the frames and the intro are as the earlier lane left them.
use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.
